goals: Provide fail-closed Xaero Minimap radar-icon capture for the 37 Naturalist living entities whose rendered ModelPart hierarchy is not captured by Xaero's native path.

Preserve Xaero's native successful model and texture capture for Brown Bear, Bird, Butterfly, Catfish, Caterpillar, Crab, Deer, Firefly, Snake, and Snail; C22 is external/user-reported Starfish PASS with its complete five-arm live-body-center mechanism retained by C23, which only reduces that scale and source-audits the two Scorpion live-body-center contracts without modifying Naturalist, Xaero, EMF, or Ribbits.
scope: Use a closed Naturalist entity-id plus exact current model-class contract registry. Each contract selects the live renderer-selected adult, baby, or state model subtree; unknown class, path, trace, or draw failure delegates to Xaero's normal fallback.

After Xaero's native model prerender returns empty, render only the selected head/neck subtree for ordinary headed animals, or an explicit compact-body subtree for the documented non-headed anatomy families. The bridge copies only contract-path ancestor transforms and resolves only an explicit contract trace anchor, selected part, or contract-path ancestor trace; it never mutates or reparents the live Naturalist model.

Use explicit contract-local scale, rotation, source-audited trace anchor, and only where unavoidable a source-audited direct-cuboid subset for the C4 presentation corrections. Brown Bear has no custom fallback contract and remains its runtime-proven `RadarIconSpriteForm` request at `0.65F`. C20 Clam is external/user-reported PASS with its authored `top` source and trace unchanged. C23 retains Starfish's normalized copied `body`/`legs` five-arm assembly, top-down orientation, live `body` trace, and live-body direct-cuboid render center while changing only scale from `0.58F` to `0.52F`. Exact C8 audit confirms both Scorpion `model.root()` values are the authored root; C23 selects normalized copied `body`/`legs` and uses the live `body` for both trace and Xaero render center at existing scales. One-time diagnostics are bounded to Starfish or the two Scorpions and empty-destination failure semantics remain intact. No screen-space offsets are used. Resource reload evicts only the 37 fallback targets and native Brown Bear entries.

exclusions: Naturalist source, artifact, version, controls, gameplay, networking, private assets, and renderer behavior remain owned by projects/naturalist.

Xaero, XaeroLib, Xaero × EMF, Ribbits × Xaero, vanilla entities, unrelated modded models, normal successful Xaero captures, category/visibility settings, and cache entries outside the 37 target Naturalist types plus native Brown Bear resource-reload entries are not intercepted.

duck_egg and dirt_trail are not mob-icon targets. No static artwork, copied Naturalist or Xaero assets/classes, arbitrary class-name discovery, species-specific screen-space offsets, whole-model fallback for ordinarily headed animals, runtime deployment, or protected-gameplay-instance access is included.
